notes: Dimensions and mass come from Kyocera's OWN spec sheet PDF (Echo_Spec_Sheet.pdf, footer '©2011 Kyocera Communications Inc. (KCI), San Diego California, USA', dated 3/11), retrieved via web.archive.org snapshot 2011-04-28 of the Kyocera-operated microsite echobykyocera.com - PRIMARY, not the Sprint carrier release. Kyocera states both inches and millimetres; the millimetre values are Kyocera's own, so no conversion was needed. The two Kyocera Americas press releases supply the announce and availability dates; the Feb 7 2011 release says only 'available this spring' - the exact April 17 date comes from Kyocera's March 21 2011 developer-program release. Kyocera never publishes an open/unfolded dimension - open left entirely null; the closed figure is the phone with the second display stowed under the first. Kyocera states 'WVGA 262K-color TFT (x2)' - TFT recorded as LCD per the SPEC enum. Combined display is 4.7" diagonal (Kyocera's 'Tablet Mode'); not recorded as a third physical display. hinge.type left null: Kyocera calls it a 'Unique, patent-pending, pivot hinge' and adds 'Kyocera used a Super Copper Alloy and advanced structural analysis to create a three-dimensional hinge design so unique it has six patents pending' - there is no matching value in the SPEC enum and Kyocera publishes no angle. Processor 1GHz Snapdragon (QSD8650); two 1370 mAh Li-Ion batteries shipped in box. hinge.axis is NULL on purpose: Kyocera states no axis. Its pivot hinge slides the lower display out and up so the two screens end up stacked along the long axis, but that is a reading of Kyocera's product photos, not a published value.
